akd.summary: AuthKit daemon. Handles Apple Account sign-in: it stores and refreshes the authentication tokens that iCloud, the App Store and other Apple services use.
akd.why: Runs whenever you're signed in with an Apple Account.
akd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

appleaccountd.summary: Apple Account daemon. Manages your Apple Account (iCloud) sign-in state and which services are enabled for it.
appleaccountd.why: Runs while you are signed in to iCloud.
appleaccountd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

AKFollowUpExtension.summary: Shows 'follow-up' items for your Apple Account, such as 'Account needs attention' or 'Verify your phone number', in System Settings.
AKFollowUpExtension.why: Runs when macOS checks whether your Apple Account has pending actions.

followupd.summary: CoreFollowUp daemon. Collects pending follow-up tasks (finish iCloud setup, update account details, repair Keychain) and raises the red badge in System Settings.
followupd.why: Runs in the background for every signed-in user.

AOSHeartbeat.summary: Apple Online Services heartbeat. Periodically checks in so iCloud-related services know this Mac is still active on your account.
AOSHeartbeat.why: Part of the iCloud account machinery.

cdpd.summary: Cloud Data Protection daemon. Handles iCloud end-to-end encryption keys and account recovery (recovery contacts/keys, Advanced Data Protection).
cdpd.why: Runs while signed in to iCloud.
cdpd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

TrustedPeersHelper.summary: Maintains the 'circle of trust' of your Apple devices that can share iCloud Keychain and other end-to-end encrypted data.
TrustedPeersHelper.why: Runs while iCloud Keychain / Passwords sync is on.
TrustedPeersHelper.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

Keychain Circle Notification.summary: Shows the approval prompts when a new device asks to join your iCloud Keychain circle.
Keychain Circle Notification.why: Appears briefly when you set up a new device with your Apple Account.

keychainsharingmessagingd.summary: Delivers messages used to share passwords and passkeys between you and family or contacts (Shared Passwords groups).

AppleCredentialManagerDaemon.summary: Manages credentials you can move between apps and devices: passkeys, passwords, and credential import/export.
AppleCredentialManagerDaemon.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

AuthenticationServicesAgent.summary: Powers Sign in with Apple, passkeys and AutoFill credential prompts for apps and websites.
AuthenticationServicesAgent.why: Runs on demand when an app asks to sign you in.

PasswordBreachAgent.summary: Checks whether your saved passwords appear in known data breaches (Security Recommendations in the Passwords app). It does this privately without sending your passwords.
PasswordBreachAgent.why: Runs periodically if Passwords is in use.

amsaccountsd.summary: Apple Media Services accounts daemon: manages the sign-in used for the App Store, Music, TV, Books and Podcasts purchases.
amsaccountsd.why: Runs for any app that uses your Apple media account.
amsaccountsd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

amsengagementd.summary: Apple Media Services engagement daemon. Handles in-app and system messages from the App Store and Apple media services (promotional or account notices).
amsengagementd.why: Runs in the background for media services.

storekitagent.summary: StoreKit agent. Handles in-app purchases and subscriptions on behalf of apps.
storekitagent.why: Runs when an app uses the App Store for purchases or receipts.

commerce.summary: CommerceKit helper for the Mac App Store. Does the actual download, install and update work for App Store apps.
commerce.why: Runs when the App Store installs or updates apps.

fairplayd.summary: FairPlay DRM daemon. Verifies licences for protected content such as App Store apps, Apple Music and TV purchases.
fairplayd.why: Runs when protected Apple content is opened.
fairplayd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

familycircled.summary: Family Sharing daemon. Syncs family membership, shared purchases and Screen Time/Ask to Buy approvals.
familycircled.why: Runs if you use Family Sharing.

FamilyIntents.summary: Siri and Shortcuts actions for Family Sharing.

eligibilityd.summary: Eligibility daemon. Decides which features are available on this device based on region, hardware and settings, for example whether Apple Intelligence can be used.
eligibilityd.why: Runs at startup and when the region or language changes.
eligibilityd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

countryd.summary: Determines your country/region from signals such as Wi-Fi and cell data so regional features and legal requirements can be applied.
countryd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

tzd.summary: Time-zone daemon. Works out the current time zone from your location and keeps time-zone rules up to date.
tzd.why: Runs so the Mac can adjust the clock automatically when you travel.
tzd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

timed.summary: Time sync daemon. Keeps the system clock accurate using network time servers (NTP).
timed.why: Always running; it replaced the older ntpd.
timed.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

clocksyncd.summary: Keeps your Mac's clock synchronised with other devices and clocks (for example for AirPlay/HomePod audio sync).

adid.summary: Advertising identifier daemon. Manages the ad-tracking ID and the Apple advertising/privacy settings that go with it.

SubmitDiagInfo.summary: Packages and sends diagnostic and usage data to Apple if you opted in under System Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements.
SubmitDiagInfo.why: Starts periodically (usually overnight). Turn off sharing to stop it.

analyticsd.summary: Analytics daemon. Collects anonymous diagnostics and usage metrics that go to Apple if you allowed it.
analyticsd.why: Always running, though it only uploads data if you opted in.
analyticsd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

analyticsagent.summary: Per-user analytics agent that feeds the analytics daemon with usage data.
analyticsagent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

osanalyticshelper.summary: Helper that writes OS analytics and crash/diagnostic logs.
osanalyticshelper.why: Runs briefly after crashes or at scheduled times.

inputanalyticsd.summary: Collects statistics about keyboard and input use (such as which keyboards and languages you use) for improvement of text input features.

rtcreportingd.summary: Real-Time Communication reporting. Sends call-quality metrics from FaceTime and similar calling to Apple.

Siri.summary: The Siri app process: speech and responses, 'Hey Siri', and the Siri window.

Siri AI.summary: The Siri / Apple Intelligence experience (conversational Siri and on-screen actions).
Siri AI.why: Runs when Siri or Apple Intelligence is enabled.

SiriNCService.summary: Siri notification-centre service. Shows Siri suggestions and results in Notification Center.

siriactionsd.summary: Runs Siri actions and Shortcuts for you, including requests from apps via App Intents.

siriinferenced.summary: Runs Siri's machine-learning models on your Mac for understanding requests.

generativeexperiencesd.summary: Apple Intelligence daemon for generative features (Writing Tools, summaries, Image Playground). It coordinates the on-device models.
generativeexperiencesd.why: Runs when Apple Intelligence features are used or prepared.

GenerativeExperiencesSafetyInferenceProv.summary: Runs on-device safety checks on content produced by Apple Intelligence features.

TGOnDeviceInferenceProviderService.summary: Runs Apple Intelligence language models on your Mac (on-device inference). Can use a lot of CPU, GPU and memory while generating.
TGOnDeviceInferenceProviderService.why: Starts when a feature that uses on-device text generation runs.

modelmanagerd.summary: Manages Apple Intelligence and machine-learning models on this Mac: downloading, loading and unloading them.
modelmanagerd.why: Runs when apps need an on-device model.

modelcatalogd.summary: Keeps the catalogue of available Apple Intelligence / ML models and their versions.
modelcatalogd.why: Runs periodically and when models are updated.

mlhostd.summary: Machine learning host. Runs ML inference for system features in a sandboxed helper.

IntelligencePlatformComputeService.summary: Compute service for the Apple Intelligence platform: runs personal-context tasks on-device.

intelligencecontextd.summary: Builds the personal context (from your apps and activity) that Apple Intelligence and Siri use. It stays on device.
intelligencecontextd.why: Runs in the background when Apple Intelligence is on.

privatecloudcomputed.summary: Talks to Apple's Private Cloud Compute servers for Apple Intelligence requests too big to run locally.
privatecloudcomputed.why: Runs when such a request is made.

PCCAgentClientExtension.summary: Client extension for Apple's Private Cloud Compute: sends requests securely to Apple servers.

aned.summary: Apple Neural Engine daemon. Schedules machine-learning work onto the Neural Engine chip.
aned.why: Runs when ML models are used.
aned.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

mediaanalysisd.summary: Analyses photos and videos for Visual Look Up, Live Text, people and scenes. Can be busy right after importing photos.
mediaanalysisd.why: Runs in the background, mostly when idle.

knowledge-agent.summary: Siri knowledge agent. Maintains the on-device knowledge graph that Siri suggestions use.

proactived.summary: Proactive suggestions daemon. Predicts what you may want next (apps, contacts, events) and surfaces suggestions.

ospredictiond.summary: OS prediction daemon. Predicts which apps you will launch next so macOS can prepare them.

duetexpertd.summary: Part of the Duet intelligence system that learns usage patterns to schedule background work and suggestions.

contextstored.summary: Stores context signals (location, activity, device state) that on-device intelligence features use.

ContextStoreAgent.summary: Per-user agent for the context store used by suggestions and Siri.
ContextStoreAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

ContextService.summary: Provides device context information to system features and apps.

BiomeAgent.summary: Biome stream agent. Records on-device streams of app, device and usage events that power suggestions. Data stays on the Mac.
BiomeAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

peopled.summary: People suggestions daemon. Works out the contacts you interact with most for Share Sheet and Siri suggestions.

translationd.summary: Translation daemon. Powers system Translate features, running translation models on-device.

languageassetd.summary: Downloads and manages language assets (dictionaries, speech and translation models).
languageassetd.why: Runs when you add languages or keyboards.

corespeechd.summary: Core Speech daemon. Detects 'Hey Siri' and handles on-device speech recognition and dictation.
corespeechd.why: Always running when Siri or Dictation is on.

corespeechd_system.summary: System-wide Core Speech daemon that runs the always-listening 'Hey Siri' trigger detector.
corespeechd_system.why: Runs when 'Listen for Siri' is enabled.

spotlightknowledged.updater.summary: Spotlight Knowledge updater. Maintains the data behind Spotlight suggestions (knowledge cards, app and contact suggestions).

spotlightknowledged.importer.summary: Spotlight Knowledge importer. Imports content so that Spotlight can show suggestions about it.

hybridsearchd.summary: Hybrid search daemon. Combines lexical search with semantic (meaning-based) search for Spotlight and apps.

mdbulkimport.summary: Spotlight bulk import helper. Quickly indexes lots of files at once, for example after restoring or copying a big folder.

mdwrite.summary: Spotlight index writer. Commits metadata changes to the Spotlight index.

contentlinkingd.summary: Content linking daemon. Finds and links related items across apps (mentions, shared content).

CategoriesService.summary: Categories service used by Spotlight and system search to group results into categories.

com.apple.CodeSigningHelper.summary: Helper that evaluates code signatures for system services.
com.apple.CodeSigningHelper.why: Runs on demand while apps are launched or checked.

fileproviderd.summary: File Provider daemon. Powers cloud storage in Finder (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive) by managing each provider's placeholder and synced files.
fileproviderd.why: Runs whenever a cloud-storage app uses the File Provider integration.

com.apple.CloudDocs.iCloudDriveFileProvi.summary: The iCloud Drive file provider extension, which shows iCloud Drive in Finder.

fpassetmanagerd.summary: File Provider asset manager. Handles thumbnails and assets for files in cloud-storage folders.

FPCKService.summary: File Provider CloudKit service. Syncs file-provider metadata with iCloud.

CloudDocsStorageManagement.summary: Reports iCloud Drive usage to System Settings > Storage.

filecoordinationd.summary: File coordination daemon. Prevents apps from clobbering each other when they read/write the same file (NSFileCoordinator).
filecoordinationd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

revisiond.summary: Document versions daemon. Stores the automatic versions that let you 'Revert To' and browse older versions of documents.
revisiond.why: Runs when versioned documents are saved.

sharedfilelistd.summary: Maintains the shared file lists: Finder sidebar items, Recent Items, and login items lists.

storagekitd.summary: StorageKit daemon. Manages volumes and APFS containers for Disk Utility and storage features.

apfsd.summary: APFS user-space daemon. Handles APFS tasks that can't run in the kernel, such as encrypted volume management and snapshots.
apfsd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

deleted.summary: Purgeable-space cleaner. Frees disk space on demand by deleting caches and other purgeable data when storage runs low. Not related to the word 'deleted'.
deleted.why: Runs when free space is low, which can cause short CPU/disk bursts.

autofsd.summary: Automounter control daemon: lets macOS mount network home folders and shares on demand.

automountd.summary: Automounter daemon: mounts network file systems when you first use them.

ContainerMetadataExtractor.summary: Reads metadata from app containers (the sandbox folders where apps keep their data) for system features.

containermanagerd.summary: Container manager. Creates and manages app sandbox containers and their permissions.
containermanagerd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

containermanagerd_system.summary: System-wide container manager for sandboxed system apps and daemons.
containermanagerd_system.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

ScopedBookmarkAgent.summary: Stores 'security-scoped bookmarks' so sandboxed apps keep access to files and folders you gave them access to.
ScopedBookmarkAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.
ScopedBookmarkAgent.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

DiskUnmountWatcher.summary: Watches for disks that were disconnected without being ejected and posts the warning.
DiskUnmountWatcher.why: Runs while you are logged in.

KernelEventAgent.summary: Receives events from the kernel such as drives mounting or the need to show a dialog, and acts on them for the user.
KernelEventAgent.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

migrationhelper.summary: Helper for moving data and settings during macOS upgrades and migration.
migrationhelper.why: Runs after OS updates or Migration Assistant.

systemmigrationd.summary: System migration daemon. Applies data and settings migrations during/after macOS updates.

usernoted.summary: User notification daemon. Collects and delivers notifications from apps.
usernoted.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

usernotificationsd.summary: User notifications service that applies Focus filtering and delivery rules.
usernotificationsd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

UserNotificationCenter.summary: Displays alert dialogs on behalf of background daemons (for example 'App wants to access…', crash and update alerts).
UserNotificationCenter.why: Runs briefly whenever a system alert is shown.

donotdisturbd.summary: Focus / Do Not Disturb daemon. Applies your Focus modes and schedules.
donotdisturbd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

CoreServicesUIAgent.summary: Shows the system dialogs of Launch Services and Gatekeeper, such as 'App downloaded from the internet. Open?'.

ViewBridgeAuxiliary.summary: Renders secure remote views for other apps, such as Open/Save panels, the emoji viewer and Share sheets, in a separate process for sandboxing.
ViewBridgeAuxiliary.why: Spawned whenever an app shows one of those system panels.

ShortcutsViewService.summary: Displays UI for the Shortcuts app and Siri/Shortcuts actions.

CursorUIViewService.summary: Draws system text-cursor UI (for example the caret and Dictation/inline prediction indicators) for text input.
CursorUIViewService.why: Runs on demand with the text input system.

TextInputMenuAgent.summary: Menu bar input menu: the keyboard layout / input source switcher.
TextInputMenuAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

PAH_Extension.summary: Press-and-Hold. Shows the accent popup when you hold down a letter key (a becomes à, á, â…).
PAH_Extension.why: Runs when you hold a key.

imklaunchagent.summary: Input Method Kit launcher. Starts third-party and system input methods such as Chinese, Japanese and emoji input.
imklaunchagent.why: Runs while input methods are in use.

keyboardservicesd.summary: Keyboard services daemon: autocorrect, text replacement and predictive text.

pbs.summary: Pasteboard server. Provides the Services menu and text services for apps.
pbs.why: Runs while you are logged in.

TextThumbnailExtension.summary: Generates Quick Look thumbnails for text documents.

com.apple.quicklook.ThumbnailsAgent.summary: Generates Quick Look thumbnails and previews for files shown in Finder.
com.apple.quicklook.ThumbnailsAgent.why: Runs when you browse folders with previews on.

MenuBarAgent.summary: Manages the menu bar items and the 'Allow in the Menu Bar' settings.
MenuBarAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

DockControls.summary: The Dock's Control Center / settings controls extension.

DisplayControls.summary: Control Center extension for display brightness and Night Shift controls.

ScreenshotControls.summary: Extension for the Screenshot toolbar controls (Shift-Command-5).

com.apple.dock.extra.summary: Auxiliary Dock process that hosts Dock extras such as tile previews and widgets.

com.apple.dock.external.extra.arm64.summary: Auxiliary Dock process that hosts external or legacy Dock extensions for Apple silicon.

WindowManager.summary: Stage Manager and window tiling. Manages how app windows are grouped and arranged.
WindowManager.why: Runs while you are logged in.
WindowManager.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

UniversalControl.summary: Universal Control: lets one keyboard and mouse control Macs and iPads nearby.
UniversalControl.why: Runs while you are logged in.

AirDrop.summary: AirDrop Finder extension, which shows the AirDrop window in Finder.

AirPlayUIAgent.summary: AirPlay menu and controls (screen mirroring, speaker selection).
AirPlayUIAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

AirPlayXPCHelper.summary: Helper for AirPlay connections to speakers, TVs and displays.
AirPlayXPCHelper.why: Runs when AirPlay is in use.

SidecarRelay.summary: Sidecar relay: connects your Mac to an iPad that is used as a second display.

AccessibilityUIServer.summary: Draws accessibility overlays such as Zoom, Voice Control labels and Switch Control.
AccessibilityUIServer.why: Runs when accessibility features are on.

axassetsd.summary: Accessibility assets daemon: downloads and manages voices and other accessibility assets.

universalAccessAuthWarn.summary: Shows the prompt when an app asks for Accessibility (control your computer) access.

HeadphoneSettingsExtension.summary: System Settings pane for headphone features.
HeadphoneSettingsExtension.why: Runs when System Settings is open.

WallpaperAgent.summary: Wallpaper agent. Draws and changes the desktop picture and screen saver wallpapers.
WallpaperAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

AquaAppearanceHelper.summary: Helper that switches light/dark appearance and accent colors across the interface.
AquaAppearanceHelper.why: Runs while you are logged in.

PowerChime.summary: Plays the charging sound when you plug in the Mac.
PowerChime.why: Runs while you are logged in.

PowerUIAgent.summary: Shows power-related UI such as low-battery warnings and charging notices.
PowerUIAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

liveactivitiesd.summary: Live Activities daemon, which shows live widgets from apps and iPhones in the menu bar.
liveactivitiesd.why: Runs while you are logged in.

chronod.summary: ChronoKit daemon. Drives widget timelines and tells widgets when to refresh.
chronod.why: Always running while you are logged in.

WidgetRenderer_Activities.why: Runs when Live Activities are displayed.

UIKitSystem.summary: Runtime that lets iPhone and iPad apps run on your Mac (Mac Catalyst / iOS apps on Apple silicon).
UIKitSystem.why: Runs while an iPad/iPhone app is open.

ScreenTimeAgent.summary: Screen Time agent. Tracks usage and enforces limits, downtime and content restrictions.
ScreenTimeAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

ScreenTimeSettingsAgent.summary: Screen Time settings agent used by System Settings.

UsageTrackingAgent.summary: Collects app usage data for Screen Time reports.
UsageTrackingAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

ManagedSettingsAgent.summary: Applies Screen Time and managed-device restrictions to apps and websites.
ManagedSettingsAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

CMFSyncAgent.summary: Communication Filter sync agent. Keeps your call and message blocking and filtering lists in sync (blocked numbers, filtering unknown senders).
CMFSyncAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

dmd.summary: Device Management daemon. Applies configuration profiles and managed settings (MDM, Screen Time restrictions).
dmd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

assessmentagent.summary: Automatic Assessment Configuration agent. Locks down the Mac for supervised testing (education).
assessmentagent.why: Starts only when an exam/assessment app requests it.

ClassroomDeviceExpert.summary: Helper for the Classroom app used by teachers to manage student devices in schools.
ClassroomDeviceExpert.why: Runs only on devices enrolled in Classroom.

studentd.summary: Student daemon: lets a teacher's Classroom app view or control this Mac. Only active on school-managed devices.
studentd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

airportd.summary: Wi-Fi daemon. Scans for networks, joins them, and manages the Wi-Fi hardware.
airportd.why: Always running. Brief CPU spikes occur while scanning.
airportd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

WiFiAgent.summary: Wi-Fi agent. Shows the Wi-Fi menu and the 'join network' UI.
WiFiAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

wifip2pd.summary: Wi-Fi peer-to-peer daemon. Powers AWDL, the direct Wi-Fi link used by AirDrop, AirPlay, Handoff and Sidecar.
wifip2pd.why: Runs whenever those features are active.

wifivelocityd.summary: Wi-Fi diagnostics daemon, used by Wireless Diagnostics and system troubleshooting.

WirelessRadioManagerd.summary: Manages wireless radios and coexistence (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular) to avoid interference and save power.
WirelessRadioManagerd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

netbiosd.summary: NetBIOS name daemon. Lets Windows (SMB) machines on your network find this Mac by name when File Sharing is on.
netbiosd.why: Starts when file sharing is enabled.

mDNSResponderHelper.summary: Helper to mDNSResponder (Bonjour/DNS) that does privileged network operations.
mDNSResponderHelper.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

networkserviceproxy.summary: Network Service Proxy. Handles iCloud Private Relay and other system proxies for private browsing and tracking protection.
networkserviceproxy.why: Runs when Private Relay or related features are on.

neagent.summary: Network Extension agent. Runs VPN, content-filter and proxy apps (for example corporate VPNs) in your login session.
neagent.why: Runs when a VPN/filter app is active.

nehelper.summary: Network Extension helper. Coordinates VPN and network-filter apps with the system.
nehelper.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

nesessionmanager.summary: Network Extension session manager. Starts, stops and monitors VPN connections.
nesessionmanager.why: Runs when a VPN is configured.

symptomsd.summary: Symptoms daemon. Monitors network quality (Wi-Fi, cellular, DNS) and helps macOS decide when connections are poor.
symptomsd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

CommCenter.summary: Telephony and cellular manager. Handles calls, SMS relay and eSIM/cellular features, including iPhone calls on your Mac.
CommCenter.why: Runs on all Macs; mostly idle without cellular.
CommCenter.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

callservicesd.summary: Call services daemon. Handles phone and FaceTime calls, including iPhone calls on the Mac.
callservicesd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

avconferenced.summary: AV conference daemon. Does the audio/video engine work for FaceTime.

nearbyd.summary: Nearby Interaction daemon: ultra-wideband and Bluetooth ranging to nearby devices.
nearbyd.why: Runs when nearby-device features are used.

usbmuxd.summary: USB multiplexing daemon. Lets the Mac talk to iPhones and iPads connected by USB (or Wi-Fi sync).
usbmuxd.why: Runs when iOS devices are connected.

remoted.summary: Remote Device daemon. Lets Xcode and other tools discover and talk to connected iPhones, iPads, watches and Vision Pro.
remoted.why: Runs when developer or device tools are in use.

MobileDeviceUpdater.summary: Updates firmware on connected devices and accessories.

AMPDeviceDiscoveryAgent.summary: Apple Media Player device discovery. Detects connected iPhones and iPads so Finder and the Music app can sync with them.
AMPDeviceDiscoveryAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

AMPLibraryAgent.summary: Apple Media Player library agent. Gives Finder and Music access to the Music, TV and Books library on your Mac.
AMPLibraryAgent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

accessoryd.summary: Accessory daemon. Manages MFi and USB accessories and their identity.

accessoryupdaterd.summary: Accessory updater daemon. Updates firmware on supported accessories.

EAUpdaterService.summary: External Accessory updater: updates firmware of third-party accessories that talk to Apple devices.

audioaccessoryd.summary: Audio accessory daemon: pairing, case battery and firmware for AirPods and compatible headphones.
audioaccessoryd.why: Runs when AirPods or similar are connected.

heard.summary: Hearing health daemon. Powers hearing features of AirPods Pro, Headphone Accommodations and loudness notifications.
heard.why: Runs when compatible headphones are connected.

StandaloneHIDAudService.summary: Handles buttons and volume controls from USB/HID audio devices such as headsets.

UVCAssistant.summary: Camera helper for USB UVC webcams. Makes standard USB cameras available to apps.
UVCAssistant.why: Runs when a USB camera is used.

VDCAssistant.summary: Video Device Capture assistant. Provides access to built-in and some external cameras. The light comes on when apps use the camera.
VDCAssistant.why: Runs when any app opens the camera.

appleh13camerad.summary: Camera daemon for the built-in camera's image signal processor on Apple silicon (M1-generation chips).
appleh13camerad.why: Runs when the camera is in use.

cameracaptured.summary: Camera capture daemon. Coordinates camera access and the green camera indicator.
cameracaptured.why: Runs when the camera is in use.

ContinuityCaptureAgent.summary: Continuity Camera agent. Lets you use your iPhone as webcam or scanner.
ContinuityCaptureAgent.why: Runs when an iPhone is used as camera.

ptpcamerad.summary: PTP camera daemon. Lets the Mac import photos from digital cameras and phones using PTP.

mscamerad-xpc.summary: Mass-storage camera helper from Image Capture. Reads photos from camera memory cards.
mscamerad-xpc.why: Runs when a camera or card is connected.

icdd.summary: Image Capture Device daemon. Image Capture and Photos use it to talk to cameras and scanners.

ioupsd.summary: UPS monitor. Watches an attached uninterruptible power supply to shut down safely.
ioupsd.why: Runs when a UPS is connected.

usbaudiod.why: Runs when a USB audio device is connected.

IOUserBluetoothSerialDriver.summary: DriverKit Bluetooth serial driver. Provides serial-over-Bluetooth for hardware that needs it.
IOUserBluetoothSerialDriver.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

nfcd.summary: NFC daemon. Handles near-field communication for Apple Pay and tap-to-pay features if the hardware supports it.

NFStorageServer.summary: NFC storage service. Stores the secure data used for contactless features such as Wallet passes.

seserviced.summary: Secure Element service. Talks to the secure chip that stores Apple Pay card data.
seserviced.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

passd.summary: Passbook / Wallet daemon. Manages Wallet passes and Apple Pay cards.
passd.why: Runs when Wallet or Apple Pay is used.

biometrickitd.summary: Biometric daemon for Touch ID. Handles fingerprint enrollment and matching.
biometrickitd.why: Always running on Macs with Touch ID.
biometrickitd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

coreautha.summary: LocalAuthentication agent. Shows Touch ID, Apple Watch and password prompts for apps.
coreautha.why: Runs when an app asks to authenticate you.
coreautha.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

coreauthd.summary: LocalAuthentication daemon. Manages Touch ID / Apple Watch / password checks.
coreauthd.quit: Don't. It's part of macOS and is restarted automatically.

ctkd.summary: CryptoTokenKit daemon. Supports smart cards and hardware tokens.
ctkd.why: Runs when tokens or smart cards are used.

ctkahp.summary: CryptoTokenKit access helper. Lets apps use certificates stored on smart cards or the Secure Enclave.

com.apple.ifdreader.why: Runs when a smart-card reader is attached.

lockoutagent.summary: Lockout agent. Shows lock and inactivity UI after repeated failed unlock attempts or while the screen is locked.
lockoutagent.why: Runs while you are logged in.

secinitd.summary: Security initialisation daemon. Sets up the App Sandbox for apps as they launch.
